meta.name: Game durations, halftime and on-air windows
meta.rule: Official rulebook / league facts are separated from planning buffers. Any number that is not published by an official source is labelled ESTIMATE and appears on the Flagged for Review page. A blank end time means the value could not be confirmed.
meta.estimateLabel: ESTIMATION — not a real verified released schedule

official.note: MLB reported that 2025 was the third straight season with an average game time of 2:40 or less.
MLB's 2027 release says complete first-pitch times are not final; 2,015 game records carry startTimeTBD=true in StatsAPI. Times left blank.
2026 NFL Rulebook, Rule 4, Section 1, Article 3: 'there shall be an intermission of 13 minutes'.
2026 NCAA Football Rules, Rule 3, Section 2, Article 1.
2026 NCAA Football Rules, Rule 3, Section 2: 'The intermission between halves of a regular-season game shall be 20 minutes'.

official.value: Published per event (start_time / end_time on the official event page)
official.note: The network publishes a start and end for every event; these are the exact windows used on the Westwood One page, not a modelled game length.
official.sourceName: Westwood One Sports official event page (example)

official.note: KNBR 1050 says it carries three hours of pregame and every Stanford game live. This pregame is talk, not a game broadcast; it is listed for completeness and is not used to block free time.
official.sourceName: Stanford Football on KNBR 1050 (official station page)

researchReferences.note: Third-party research commonly reports NFL games near three hours and FBS college football games near three and a half hours. These are NOT official values and are not used as verified schedule data. The official rulebooks above are authoritative for playing time and halftime.
researchReferences.sourceName: Pro Football Network halftime explainer (third-party research; flagged)

researchReferences.note: Third-party trackers reported 2026 averages slightly above the official 2025 figure. Not used as a verified value; the official MLB 2:38 figure is used instead.
